screen: Line-height — 4,591 nodes on AUTO
finding: 22.4% of all text uses AUTO line-height, which no --bk-leading-* token can express — every --bk-leading-* is a fixed px, so these boards are unbuildable as drawn.
evidence: AUTO line-height on 4,591 of 20,509 TEXT nodes. Largest: Inter Regular 11/AUTO (910), 13/AUTO (591), 12/AUTO (574), 10/AUTO (392), Medium 11/AUTO (421). A further 11 nodes use percent line-heights (160%, 150%, 140%) and 600 nodes use 18 un-tokenised px values (14px 273, 15px 126, 13px 58, 12px 36, 27px 34 …).
recommend: Treat AUTO as a defect class: binding a style fixes it automatically, since all 11 styles carry an explicit px line-height.
